name: Hibiki Kohaku
source:
Hobbies: Pottery
Likes: Eastern sweets (Japanese sweets)
Dislikes: Sloppy people

Kohaku is a servant of the Mutsuki Family and captain of the Novus Orbis Librarium, and a playable character in Central Fiction. As the servant of one of the Duodecim families, he is well acquainted with their members, such as [url=/c25639]Jin Kisaragi[/url]. 
The Kohaku family is one of the Mutsuki branch families. They are trained for silent assassinations and so are rarely mentioned in historical books. As a member of this family, Hibiki was also trained in the assassination and stealth arts.

Hibiki is described as "a pretty boy with a poison tongue". His attitude towards the normally laid-back [url=/c32478]Kagura[/url] is often critical, being quick to belittle or insult him. However, in reality, this covers up his actual admiration for the Black Knight. He also has a strict personality, such as making Kagura pay for the damages he caused in the Headquarters when he fought against [url=/c26243]Arakune[/url], and making Kagura pay the electricity bill through his personal bank account for when [url=/c20689]Kokonoe[/url] used 80% of the headquarter's electric power output to repair Iron Tager. He is also known to be an excellent cook, where even [url=/c25640]Rachel[/url] had highly praised his cooking.

One of his mottoes is: "A man with confidence shall not lose; only doubt will bring defeat".
